verdict.rationale: turbopuffer documents API tokens that can be created and expired in the dashboard, which covers the API-key part of the story. Its permissions guidance is an application-side pattern: you store user or group IDs on documents and pass them as query filters. That is a developer building block rather than enforced access control, so it earns no credit here. missing for 10: role-based access control, per-namespace (per-collection) scoped keys or permissions, read/write operation-level scoping, server-enforced granular authorization, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can enforce granular access control (API keys, roles, per-collection permissions) on database operations

citations.quote: You can create and expire tokens in the dashboard.
